facts.meaning: pbCanSwitchOut? permits fainted immediately, then active CertainSwitching ability/item callbacks, then Ghost when MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS(defaulttrue); only afterwards checks trappedInBattle and opposing trapping ability/item callbacks. Thus Ghost bypasses those later trapping checks at this location but not missing battler access. Callback order is abilities before items, then type shortcut; no write/register actual party swap occurs in this predicate.
facts.control: The type flag does not make any incoming party Pokemon valid and does not bypass separate pbCanSwitchIn? caller checks. False/trapping branches may display only when partyScene supplied. Other callbacks can return true before the type read.
facts.failure_prefix: Predicate callback/display may perform its own effects or raise, interrupting later checks. This wrapper has no rollback/ensure; no transfer, save or battle decision is directly set.
facts.open: Complete CertainSwitching/trapping callbacks, type identity/active predicates and all caller switch-in validation remain independently scoped.

facts.meaning: pbCanRun? first rejects trainer battle and rejects !canRun for player-side battler, then Ghost+MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS shortcut before active certain-escape callbacks/traps. pbRun differs: opposing wild battler only registers Run choice and returns-1; player reaches Debug handling/trainer forfeit/global!canRun first. Only !duringBattle block applies Ghost/certain-ability/item escape and trapping gates. Ghost escape plays fleeSE and pausedmessage before settingdecision3/return1. duringBattle skips that entire group and falls through speed chance, without incrementing runCommand.

Debug cancel returns-1 without ordinary flee attempt. Speed branch uses raw speed/fastest opposing speed(min1), setsrate256 if faster else speed*128/enemy+runCommand*30, and compares AI random256 only whenrate<256.
facts.failure_prefix: Opposing choice fields write sequentially. Ordinary runCommand increments before later chance/audio/message failure; successful-branchdecision3 is written only after audio/message return. A failure there can leave run attempt increment/effects without decision. No automatic rollback or actual escape guarantee from predicate.
facts.open: AI RNG distribution/active callbacks/scene/audio effects and all external run callers remain independently scoped; source return-1 is branch-specific, not always failed attempted flee.

facts.meaning: pbReplace gets party/current party index, initializes new battler, swaps partyOrder entries, then pbSendOut, then only when RECALCULATE_TURN_ORDER_AFTER_SPEED_CHANGES(defaulttrue) requests pbCalculatePriority(false,[idxBattler]). This is a post-sendout request for the replacement index, not a general promise every stat mutation instantly sorts all actions. It does not itself call pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle in this method; full caller entry path remains separate.

facts.meaning: pbEffectsOnBattlerEnteringPosition processes HealingWish then LunarDance. Wish true and healableHP or status!=NONE requests animation/message, recoversHP, curesstatus, then clears flag. If no benefit it clears only MECH<8; >=8 retains for later entrant. Lunar also checks any move.pp<total_pp and, on benefit, recovers/cures/restores each PP before clearing; no benefit uses same<8 clear. These are independent position flags, not the earlier move's success probability.
facts.control: At defaultMECH8 an already healthy/status-free/fullPP entrant retains both applicable flags; missingPP alone consumes only Lunar. Order can make Lunar HP/status benefit disappear after Wish, while PP still qualifies independently. Expiration is not unconditional on entry.
facts.failure_prefix: Animations/messages precede HP/status/PP effects and flag clear. Failure can retain flag after HP/status or some PP already restored; rerun can have different benefit conditions. No rollback/transaction. PP scan getter failure occurs before Lunar benefit action.
facts.open: Complete recovery/status/PP setters and all caller entry/hazard behavior are independently scoped; no whole Healing Move family or native scene acceptance.

facts.meaning: Obedience returns true before settings for multiturn/nonUseMove/noninternal/nonplayer-owned battler. Badge threshold=10*(badgecount+1), replaced by GrowthRate.max_level at>=8 badges. ANY(defaultfalse) OR (FOREIGN(defaulttrue)&&Pokemon.foreign?(player)) permits high-level check only when level>threshold; computes floor((level+threshold)*battleRand256/256) and marks disobedient when>=threshold. HyperMode obedience is ORed independently. If disobedient, pbDisobey clears Rage then can choose another allowed move by updating choice1/2/3, sleep, confusion selfdamage or refusal; only alternate-move choice returns true here.
facts.control: Flags enable a conditional random test, not guaranteed disobedience above threshold; ANYfalse does not disable HyperMode check or enabled foreign branch. foreign? definition/actualOwner data are separate. The HyperMode method call is still evaluated on the OR-assignment expression; no prose boolean-shortcut claim replaces actual source.
facts.failure_prefix: Debug log before Rage clear; refusal messages can fail after clear. Alternate choice writes are sequential after candidate selection. Sleep/selfdamage callbacks can mutate before returningfalse. No restore of original choice or HP/Rage on later failure.
facts.open: Complete Pokemon foreign/HyperMode/native RNG/status/damage handlers and caller choices/PP sequencing remain independently scoped; no command UI or actual distribution guarantee.

facts.meaning: pbConfusionBerry unforced requires canHeal and canConsumePinchBerry?(MECH>=7). Pinch helper first rejects opposing Unnerve/AsOne, then permits HP<=quarter, or HP<=half when !checkGluttony OR activeGluttony. Thus<=6 berry method passesfalse and halfHP works withoutGluttony;>=7 quarter normally/halfGluttony. Heal divisor8 throughgen6,2 gen7,3 >=8 using integer totalHP division, doubled by activeRipen before pbRecoverHP. Forced bypasses heal/pinch guards and eat-animation, but still mayRipen. Disliked nature lowering confuse_stat requests confuse_msg and mayself-confuse after HP recovery.
facts.control: Method returns true even when forced recovery returns0; it does not remove/consume item itself. No claim confusion is unconditional: requires nature decrease and pbCanConfuseSelf?. CanConsumeBerry is shared Unnerve guard, not bypassed merely by large HP fraction.
facts.failure_prefix: Item name/ability splash/eat animation precede HP recovery; recovery precedes dislike message/confusion. Failure can retain healedHP without confusion/without caller item consumption. No rollback or always-one-HP guarantee for small totalHP division; receiver recovery has separate semantics.
facts.open: Complete pbRecoverHP/activeAbility/nature/confusion and held-item wrapper removal callbacks remain separately received necessary units; no entire Items or Ability family acceptance.
